title: Mace Windu
description: Jedi Master Mace Windu was skeptical of Qui-Gon Jinn's desire to train young Anakin Skywalker in the ways of the Force. After the events of the Battle of Naboo and the death of Qui-Gon, Windu spoke with Jedi Master Yoda about the threat of the Sith. The two agreed that an unseen Master was behind Darth Maul.
